title: 2020-02-28 Meeting notes - User management GitHub & Azure DevOps
content:
08:07

Meeting Date: 2020-02-27 15:00

Location: Malmö Central - 2nd floor - 204

Invitation Message

Hej,


Skall skriva sammanfattande dokumentation kring CI / CD setup för pliot som underlag men i princip kokar agende för detta möte ner till senaste mail i frågan:


Here the tool chain for DEXF pilot is described:

https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVOPS/pages/1056243752/Build+and+deploy+pipeline


Here status for a functional CI pipeline is described:

https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVOPS/pages/1056178321/Pilot+tool+chain



We need to decide how we want to progress DEXF pilot and collaborate with project headed by Edwin.


So as understand it there are two tracks?


  1. Me and Jimmy has a working integration between Jira, Azure DevOps and GitHub that we want to use for DEXF as a pilot.
    User handling is however outstanding in the setup to be able to start the pilot.
    @Gaurang When I talked to you last Friday you were about to finalize the setup of AD user groups that would be used in the GitHub application in Azure AD to handle users in GitHub. You took the action point to align with Jathisan and set up a meeting where we configure GitHub integration. The AD user groups would as well give access to Azure DevOps. @Gaurang How is this progressing?
  2. @Edwin You are starting up an initiative / POC that will set the WoW and integrations of Confluence, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps and Azure AD.


How should we do above activities so that we collaborate in a good way?

One way to do the DEXF pilot without any risk of affecting existing products would be to set up a IPEX GitHub organization and integrate that to Jira/Azure DevOps/Azure AD. Comments?


/joakim


Participants

(Meeting Organizer)

(Accepted in Outlook)

Notes

To be able to start using GitHub as VCS in IPEX we need to have access to Teams functionality in GitHub.

It is as well a goal to integrate to Azure AD for good user handling but this can be a second step.

To minimize risk and to be able to move forward it is best if IPEX get and manage own GitHub cloud enterprise organization.

See as well links in meeting invite for background information.


Actions:

 Will contact CBF procurement to get IPEX GitHub Cloud Enterprise Cloud license i.e. GitHub organization.
